name: r18_linear_pattern_pitch_unchanged
why: Five holes at pitch 30 along a plate that gets longer. The pitch is a feature dimension -- the holes are 30 mm from one another because the drawing says so -- and it has nothing to do with the length of the part. If lengthening the plate changes the pitch, the pattern followed the wrong thing.
intent_why: pitch 30 and first instance where the designer put it: lengthening the plate leaves all five holes where they are. The invariant is written «same_as_before» and not as numbers, because the DIRECTION of the pattern is chosen by SOLIDWORKS from the edge, and computing it by hand would mean guessing which way it goes -- a wrong calculation here would turn the case into a false silence.

after.tolerance_why: the cylinder axis is read from CylinderParams, which returns metres
five holes of 9: the diameter is read from CylinderParams
